entries.zh: 反覆；翻来覆去、反复无常；再回来办理应办之事
entries.en: to turn back to the matter again and again; to reconsider; (of persons) inconstant, capricious

entries.zh: 屏退；退避、退出（王前）〔暂拟〕
entries.en: to withdraw, retire from (the king's) presence (tentative)
entries.notes: 汉字「屏」带 [疑] 且 M 栏声调 T99 污损，西语词头「Boluer del rey」不合常例，按屏=屏退、退出王前暂拟。

entries.zh: 翻转；倒转（把物翻面、反转过来）
entries.en: to turn the reverse way, turn inside out (volver del revés)
entries.notes: 第二汉字带 [疑:輦/拼]，据词头 volver del revés 与「轉」字定翻转义。

entries.zh: 翻覆；翻转过来（翻个面）
entries.en: to turn over, reverse, turn inside out
entries.notes: 首字「屏」承上条存疑（上条带 [疑]），以「覆」加词头 volver del revés 定翻覆义。

entries.zh: 退还；退还款项、偿还
entries.en: to pay back, repay; to return (money)

entries.zh: 退还官职；卸任交还官职
entries.en: to return one's office, hand back the post (resign)
entries.notes: 词头尾部「naleguecer」字迹难辨，据「退還官職」与 M/R 栏定交还官职义。

entries.zh: 退还人；债款或字据（商号账款、书信票据）退还给人
entries.en: to return the debts, or the letters/bills of the company, to the person

entries.zh: 退辞；推辞谢绝、退还不受
entries.en: to refuse and send back, decline what is offered
entries.notes: M 栏声调 T99 污损且词头字迹难辨（refusa 疑指拒绝），据「退辭」暂拟推辞义。

entries.zh: 退后；后退、退回原处
entries.en: to step back, go back, fall back

entries.zh: 运；运转、旋转（环绕转动）
entries.en: to turn, revolve, go round

entries.zh: 运转；绕转、环绕而行
entries.en: to turn round; to go about, circle
entries.notes: M 栏第二声调 T99 污损且夹有西语 rodear 字样，据「運轉」暂拟。

entries.zh: 旋；转身、旋转（自转一圈）
entries.en: to turn oneself round, spin about
entries.notes: M「Goān」/R「lîen」与「旋」对音不合，据词头 volverse al rededor 加「旋」定义。

entries.zh: 归着；带着答复回来（回话回报）〔暂拟〕
entries.en: to come back with a reply, return with an answer (tentative)
entries.notes: 「歸着」搭配罕见、R 栏对音有出入，据词头 volver con respuesta 暂拟回话义。

entries.zh: 复命；使命完成回来交差回报
entries.en: to report back on completing one's mission; to return and render account

entries.zh: 交还职任；任满卸任、交回官职（返乡）
entries.en: to hand back one's post at the end of the term of office; return to one's town
entries.notes: 末字带 [疑:任/伍]，据词头任满返乡语境定交还职任义。

entries.zh: 乡官；乡里的官吏（地方官）
entries.en: a local official / mandarin of the town
entries.notes: 词头与汉字栏对应松散（疑串行），据「鄉官」与 M 栏 mandarín del pueblo 定义。

entries.zh: 乡官；乡里的官长
entries.en: a local official / village mandarin
entries.notes: 与前条「鄉官」重出且 M 栏字迹不全，按同一义处理。

entries.zh: 乡村；村庄、乡野
entries.en: village, countryside, hamlet
entries.notes: 词头与本条不合（疑串行），据「鄉村」与 M 栏 aldea 定村落义。

entries.zh: 复职；官复原职、恢复职务
entries.en: to be reinstated in one's post, restored to office
entries.notes: 词头与本条不对应（疑串行），据「復職」与 M/R 栏定复职义。

entries.zh: 还复；归还、恢复原状
entries.en: to give back, restore; to return to the former state
entries.notes: 词头「Boluer el remo no」字迹难辨，据「還復」定归还义。

entries.zh: 回送；回礼、回赠（送还礼物）
entries.en: to give a present in return, send back a gift

entries.zh: 急转去；急忙转身回去〔暂拟〕
entries.en: to turn round and go back at once, in haste (tentative)
entries.notes: 西语栏注明塗改并有删字、R 栏声调 T99 污损，据「急轉去」暂拟。
